copy.curiosityHook: Everyone caught at Granny's cottage has an entirely different version of the incident. Whose perspective actually explains how they all arrived there?
copy.description: When an altercation erupts at Granny's cottage, Chief Grizzly and Detective Bill Stork interrogate a karate-kicking Red, an oafish Woodsman, and a sarcastic Wolf to piece together the truth from the end backward.
copy.vibeSummary: A funny, lighthearted animated whodunit that keeps family movie night brisk, engaging, and easy to enjoy.
copy.whyWatch: Cory Edwards flips a traditional fairy tale into a witty, fast-talking crime mystery that pieces together conflicting witness stories with playful comic energy.

allowedMaterial: Chief Grizzly and Detective Bill Stork investigating the disturbance
Interrogations of Red, Granny, the sarcastic Wolf, and the Woodsman
Retelling the Little Red Riding Hood fable from the end backwards
Comedy, animation, and mystery premise elements
excludedMaterial: Identity of the true villain or culprit
